name: chronoeon-workspace
description: ChronoEon (时元) — a calm, local-first calendar and entries app.

scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:storage && npm run test:app
scripts.check: npm run check:shared && npm run build && npm run test:shared && npm run test:storage && npm run test:app
scripts.test:shared: npm run test --workspace @chronoeon/domain && npm run test --workspace @chronoeon/markdown
scripts.check:shared: npm run check --workspace @chronoeon/domain && npm run check --workspace @chronoeon/markdown && npm run check --workspace @chronoeon/ports && npm run check --workspace @chronoeon/storage
